verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs hardware-isolated VMs close to users, so edge-compute connection handling is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions WebSockets or persistent real-time connections. Regional VMs, Anycast routing and Elixir clustering are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps
